title: Regime-Aware PTF Prototype Plan
leakage_guards: Finalized PTF target columns are not features.
Same-hour finalized PTF is forbidden as a feature.
Same-hour realized SMF/YAL/YAT are forbidden as ex-ante features.
Historical interim-mcp oracle data is forbidden.
The next feature store must include only anchor-time safe information.

horizon_policy.h1_h4: Short-horizon model evaluation slice in future training; in current audit, H1-H4 is reported only as delivery-hour diagnostic unless anchor horizons are explicitly built.
horizon_policy.full_h24: All delivery hours 0-23; required for day-ahead market simulation and regime coverage.

build_regime_labels.py.purpose: Create finalized-PTF labels and lag24 persistence evaluation columns.

audit_persistence_failures.py.purpose: Create persistence failure alpha map by hour, regime, transition, residual load, load-KGUP gap, and outage stress.

next_step_after_approval: Build leakage-safe regime feature store, then train regime classifier only after feature availability audit.
